dimensions.issue_validity: Real issue filed by the maintainer. The core problem is genuine: line-loop.py explicitly declares Windows NOT supported, and uses select.select() on pipes, NamedTemporaryFile, and hardcoded /tmp -- all of which fail on native Windows Python. Two of five bugs (C1, M3) describe code that doesn't exist in upstream yet.
dimensions.actionability: Provides specific line numbers, environment details, and proposed fixes. Three verifiable bugs (C2 NamedTemporaryFile, C3 cleanup ordering, M1 hardcoded /tmp) are immediately actionable. The fundamental select.select() incompatibility is the primary blocker.
dimensions.project_relevance: Highly relevant. The plugin is distributed via Claude Code marketplace to potentially Windows users.
dimensions.priority_signal: Moderate priority. File explicitly declares Windows unsupported, so this is more of a feature request. The remaining blocker (claude -p zero stdout on Windows) means even with all 5 fixes, cook phase still doesn't work.
dimensions.duplicate_check: Not a duplicate of any open issue.

rationale: Valid issue from the maintainer reporting real Windows incompatibilities. Three of five bugs are directly verifiable in current code. Two bugs describe the author's local patched version. The fundamental select.select() incompatibility is the primary blocker, and the upstream Claude Code issue further limits impact.
